macros.name: callout
macros.doc: The \callout macro simply typesets its argument in 9-point Helvetica as per the IEEE Computer Society Press guidelines.

macros.name: dobeforekey
macros.doc: Store a command to execute before a given bibliography key.

macros.name: email
macros.doc: For convenience, IEEEconf provides an affiliation environment for typesetting affiliations and an \email macro for typesetting e-mail addresses.

macros.name: extrareflistcode
macros.doc: The \extrareflistcode macro specifies extra code to execute as part of the second argument to \begin{list} when typesetting the document’s References section.
